traits.name: Leaf Camouflage
traits.text:
While unmoving, the sorcerer is
indistinguishable from an ordinary cluster of leaves.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: The sorcerer’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 11). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components: * 1/day each: animal friendship, color spray, fog cloud
